blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73 % 73\% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77 % 77\% . Is that gap error or something systematic?
We model the systematic component as coding style ψ \psi , a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as p ⁡ ( code ∣ note , ψ ) p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},\psi) , estimating ψ \psi with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39–49 F1 converge to 52–56 once style is supplied (All p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.
blocks.zh:
在自动临床编码中,标签空间跨越数以万计的诊断和程序代码,模型目前根据单一的金注进行评价,将任何偏差都视为错误。 但我们发现,当两支队伍编码相同的110 ACI-Bench相遇时,他们只同意73%的编码(Jaccard相似性)为同一注解;即使在独立临床审计删除错误代码后,协议只上升到77 % 77 % 。 差距错误还是系统性的?
我们模拟系统组件为编码样式\\ psi, 编码器或站点特定政策, 处理代码和记录的多少, 并将编码重编为 p\ \\ (代码 \\ 注释 ,\ \ ) p(\ mathrm{ code\ mid\ mathrm{ note},\ psi) , 估计\ \ psi 的编码值为 10 度。 如果风格是噪音, 调节它不会做什么。 相反,在5个数据集中,一个以数据匹配风格为条件的模型将ICD F1提升高达26分,一个极端不匹配将它降低高达21分. 一旦提供样式(所有p < 0.05 p < 0.05),将跨越39-49 F1的四种即时编码方法汇合到52-56。 用于模型错误的单金评价费大多是可回收的,没有模型的风格.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Automated clinical coding, the task of translating clinical notes into alphanumeric codes for billing and reimbursement purposes, is usually framed as an extreme multi-label classification problem measured with F1 against a single gold annotation. This hides the assumption that every competent coder, given the same note and same guidelines, would produce the same codes. In practice they do not: even expert coders working from identical notes routinely disagree ( Crammer et al., 2007 ; Miñarro-Giménez et al., 2018 ) . This is unsurprising in a label space of roughly 72,000 billable ICD-10-CM codes (diagnoses) and 10,000 CPT codes (procedures) ( CMS, 2024 ) , where coders rely on learned shortcuts and local convention.
blocks.zh: 自动临床编码(Automatical capital coding),是将临床笔记翻译为字母编码用于计费和偿还目的的任务,通常被设定为用F1对单金注解测量的极端多标签分类问题. 这掩盖了一个假设,即每个主管的编码员,根据同样的注释和同样的准则,都会产生相同的编码. 在实践中,它们并没有:即使是使用相同笔记的专家编码员也经常不同意(Crammer等人,2007年;Miñarro-Giménez等人,2018年)。 在大约72,000个可计费的ICD-10-CM代码(诊断)和10,000个CPT代码(程序)(CMS, 2024)的标签空间中,这一点并不奇怪,其中编码者依赖于学到的捷径和当地的公约.

blocks.en: How much do they disagree, and why? On 110 public ACI-Bench encounters, two independent annotation teams (ACI-Y, ACI-M) agree on only 73 % 73\% of their codes (Jaccard similarity) despite coding identical notes, and an independent clinical audit that removes not-defensible codes only lifts this to 77 % 77\% (Appendix A ). When the note is held fixed, one hypothesis, dominant in the literature, treats this gap as error and inter-annotator variation, an irreducible cost of the expertise a vast code space demands. We examine a second, largely overlooked hypothesis, echoing a broader shift toward treating human label variation as signal rather than noise ( Plank, 2022 ; Weber-Genzel et al., 2024 ) : that part of the disagreement is systematic. We call this systematic component coding style , a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much documentation to require; the name is a matter of convenience, and the same concept could be called a coder’s policy, philosophy, or conventions. The two hypotheses are not exclusive: real disagreement is some mixture of error and style. Figure 1 shows one case in which the same note receives disjoint code sets from the two teams, yet a professional clinical-coding auditor judged every code defensible (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 他们不同意多少,为什么? 在110场公开的ACI-Bench相遇中,两支独立的注释小组(ACI-Y,ACI-M)尽管编码相同,却只商定了73%的73\%代码(Jacccard相似性),并进行了独立的临床审计,删除了不可防御代码,但只将这一数字提高到77%的77\%(附录A). 当该笔记被固定时,一种在文献中占主导地位的假设将这一空白视为错误和注释者之间的变异,这是巨大的代码空间要求的专业知识不可减少的成本。 我们研究了第二个基本上被忽视的假设,回应了将人类标签变异视为信号而非噪音的更广泛转变(Plank, 2022; Weber-Genzel等人, 2024 ) : 这部分分歧是系统性的。 我们称这个系统化的元件编码风格,一个针对编码内容和需要多少文件的编码器或站点的特定政策;名称是一个方便的问题,同一个概念可以称为编码器的政策、哲学或惯例。 两种假设并不排斥:真正的分歧是错误和风格的某种混合. 图1显示一个案例,即同一注释从两个小组得到不相连的代码集,但一名专业的临床编码审计员判断每个代码都是可辩护的(附录)。

blocks.en: The distinction matters because the two are measured and remedied differently. If disagreement were purely error, better coders or trained models would converge toward the single gold set. Instead, prior systems have plateaued and transfer poorly: supervised label-attention encoders ( Mullenbach et al., 2018 ) , direct LLM prompting ( Boyle et al., 2023 ) , and retrieval-plus-verification pipelines ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) are all trained and scored against one gold set per note, and their accuracy degrades across MIMIC versions ( Edin et al., 2023 ) , across hospitals ( Ponthongmak et al., 2023 ) , and across admission years ( Blanco et al., 2020 ) . The common response is to fine-tune a separate model per site, which is expensive and treats a site’s conventions as something to learn into the weights of the model rather than describe.
blocks.zh: 这种区别很重要,因为两者的衡量和补救不同。 如果分歧纯粹是错误,那么更好的编码员或训练有素的模型就会向单一的金币组合汇合. 相反,以往的系统对调和和转移情况不佳:受监督的标签注意编码器(Mullenbach等人,2018年),直接LLM提示(Boyle等人,2023年),以及回收加核查管道(Yuan等人,2025年)均经过培训并按每张纸币一套黄金计分,其准确性在MIMIC版本(Edin等人,2023年),在医院(Ponthongmak等人,2023年)和住院年份(Blanco等人,2020年)均有下降。 共同的反应是每个网站对一个单独的模型进行微调,这个模型很昂贵,并且把一个网站的惯例当作学习模型的权重而不是描述的东西。

blocks.en: Prior work in health economics has examined how payment models relate to coding behavior. Fee-for-service payment does not directly tie most provider payments to reported diagnoses, whereas risk-adjusted programs such as Medicare Advantage do. Geruso and Layton (2020) report that enrollees in private Medicare plans generate 6–16% higher diagnosis-based risk scores than under fee-for-service, and Kronick and Welch (2014) report that coding intensity varies widely by contract. We cite these studies only to note that coding behavior has been observed to vary across settings. We do not attempt to explain what drives style in our data; instead, we ask a narrower and testable question: whether modeling style, whatever its origin, is useful for coding.
blocks.zh: 以前在健康经济学方面的工作研究了支付模式与编码行为的关系. 服务收费付款并不直接将大多数提供者的付款与报告的诊断挂钩,而根据风险调整的方案,如 " 医疗保障优惠 " 。 Geruso和Layton(2020年)报告说,在私人医疗计划注册的患者中,基于诊断的风险分数比服务费低高6-16%,Kronick和Welch(2014年)报告说,编码强度因合同而有很大差异。 我们引用这些研究只是为了指出,据观察,编码行为因设置而异。 我们并不试图解释我们的数据中什么驱动样式;相反,我们提出一个比较狭窄和可以检验的问题:无论建模风格的起源如何,是否对编码有用.

blocks.en: If part of the disagreement is systematic, it should be measurable and controllable, and single-gold F1 should be understood as scoring style alignment as much as coding ability. We make this concrete by casting coding as p ⁡ ( code ∣ note , ψ ) p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},\psi) , where guidelines constrain which codes are admissible and style ψ \psi selects among them. We make ψ \psi measurable with a 10-dimension rubric, estimate it for each data source with a style profiler, and condition a prompt-based coder on the estimated profile at inference time, with no fine-tuning. Four coding methods that range from 39 39 – 49 49 F1 without style converge to 52 52 – 56 56 F1 once a matched style is supplied, indicating that much of the gap previously attributed to model error is unmodeled style.

We do not claim that ten dimensions capture style completely; they are deliberately coarse, and ACI-Y and ACI-M yield nearly identical averaged profiles despite disagreeing on a quarter of their codes. Because even this simplified rubric accounts for a substantial share of the gap and improves every method we test, we present our results as a lower bound on what modeling coding style can recover, with the remainder marking where genuine error begins.
blocks.zh: 我们并不声称十维捕捉风格是完全的;它们是故意粗糙的,ACI-Y和ACI-M得出了几乎相同的平均剖面图,尽管他们四分之一的代码有分歧。 因为即使这个简化的字段也占了差距的很大份额,并且改进了我们测试的每一种方法,所以我们将我们的结果作为对于什么模型编码样式可以恢复的下限,在剩下的标记中真正的错误开始的地方,我们提出.

blocks.en: We make five contributions. (C1) Framing. We recast clinical coding as p ⁡ ( code ∣ note , ψ ) p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},\psi) , separating the gap against a single gold set into genuine error and coding style ψ \psi , where guidelines fix which codes are admissible and ψ \psi selects among them. (C2) Rubric. We make ψ \psi measurable with a 10-dimension rubric (6 ICD-scope, 4 CPT-evidence; Section 3 ) estimated from (note, code-set) pairs by a style profiler. (C3) Separability. Per-encounter style vectors cluster by source (Figure 2 ), indicating that style is a property of the data source rather than per-note noise. (C4) Steerability. Conditioning a coder on a style profile at inference time, without training, changes ICD F1 by up to + 26 +26 for a matched profile and up to − 21 -21 for a mismatched one. (C5) Generality. The effect holds across coding methods: adding a style block improves two published pipelines, Two-Step ( Boyle et al., 2023 ) and Yuan-Verify ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , by 18.1 18.1 and 16.0 16.0 points, and four coders spanning 39 39 – 49 49 F1 converge to 52 52 – 56 56 F1 once style is supplied.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了五项贡献。 (C1)佛罗明. 我们把临床编码重编为p \\\ (代码 \\\ 注 ,\\ ) p(\ mathrm{code\ mid\ mathrm{note},\ psi) , 将空白与单个黄金组合区分为真正的错误和编码样式 \\ psi , 准则确定哪些代码可以接受,\ psi 在其中选择。 (C2) 鲁布里克. 我们用一个样式剖面仪从(注,代码集)对(6 ICD-scope,4 CPT-evidence;第3节)中估算出来的10个刻度(6 ICD-scope,4 CPT-evidence;第3节)来制作可测量的\psi。 (C3) 分离性。 Per-en-counter样式矢量群按源(图2),表示样式是数据源属性而非每注噪音. (C4)可引导性。 在推论时间对样式配置设定一个编码器,不经过训练,将ICD F1修改为匹配配置最多+26+26,不匹配配置最多−21-21. (C5)通论. 这个效果贯穿了编码方法:增加一个样式块可以改善两个已公布的管道,即Two-Step(Boyle等人,2023年)和Yuan-Verify(Yuan等人,2025年),增加18.1个18.1个和16.0个16.0个点,四个编码器跨越39-49个49个F1,一旦提供样式,就汇合到52个52个到56个56个F1。

blocks.en: 2 Framing
blocks.zh: 2 纵横

blocks.en: We treat clinical coding as p ⁡ ( code ∣ note , ψ ) , p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},\psi), (1) where ψ \psi defines what to include and how much documentation is required. Coding guidelines constrain the support of p p while ψ \psi shapes the choice within that support. Under this view, a “wrong” prediction against a single gold set may in fact be a valid draw from a different ψ \psi . A style profiler runs the other direction, recovering the style that a set of codes reflects: p ⁡ ( ψ ′ ∣ note , code ) , p(\psi^{\prime}\mid\mathrm{note},\mathrm{code}), (2) where ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} is the style inferred from an observed (note, code) pair. The true style behind a coder’s decisions is high-dimensional and only partly observable. Rather than model it exactly, we approximate ψ \psi with a compact, human-interpretable rubric, coarse by design, but enough to describe and transfer the dominant regularities.
blocks.zh: 我们把临床编码当作p\\(代码\\\注,\\\\),p(\mathrm{code\mid\mathrm{note},\psi),(1)其中\psi定义了要包含的内容和需要多少文件. 编码准则限制p的支持,而\ psi 则在该支持中塑造选择。 根据这一观点,对单一黄金组合的“错误”预测事实上可能是来自不同“\\ psi”的有效推断。 样式剖析器运行另一个方向, 恢复一组代码反映的样式 : p\\\\ (\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 代码), p(\ psi\\\\\\\ mid\ mathrm{note},\ mathrm{code}), (2) 从一对观察到的(注、码)推断出的样式。 编解码员决定背后的真正风格是高维的,只有部分可见. 与其确切地模拟它,我们用一个紧凑的、人性化的、粗糙的设计来形容和转移主导规律。

blocks.en: Our Approach:
blocks.zh: 我们的方针是:

blocks.en: 1. Define ψ \psi as a 10-dimension rubric (6 ICD-scope dims, 4 CPT-evidence dims), designed to describe coding style. 2. Estimate ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} per data source with a style profiler : an LLM scores 50–150 annotated encounters and the exercised (non-N/A) scores are averaged into an integer profile. 3. Condition models on ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} at inference time by prepending a natural-language <coding_style> block derived from ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} (§ 4.3 ); no fine-tuning, no per-site model.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 将\\ psi 定义为一个 10 dimension 路标( 6 个 ICD- 镜形暗号, 4 个 CPT- 证据暗号), 用于描述编码样式 。 2. 估计`\ psi^{\prime}每个数据源的样式剖析器:LLM评分50-150次附加注释的相遇,实际(非N/A)评分平均为整数剖析。 3. 在推论时间,通过预先使用源于`\ psi^{\prime}(§4.3)的自然语言的 " 编码_型 " 区块进行条件模型;不进行微调,不进行每个地点的模型。

blocks.en: 3 Rubric
blocks.zh: 3 卢比

blocks.en: The rubric has 10 dimensions (6 ICD, 4 CPT), shown in Table 1 . Each is scored 1–5 by a style profiler. ICD and CPT dimensions (S, C) are scored from the note and the associated codes (typically ground truth); these estimated styles can be applied at inference time.
blocks.zh: 标题有10个维度(6 ICD,4 CPT),如表1所示。 每个都由样式剖析器评分1–5分. ICD和CPT维度(S,C)从音符和相关的代码(通常为地面真理)中得分;这些估计样式可以在推论时应用.

blocks.en: During style determination the profiler can say N/A for any dimension not exercised by the encounter; only exercised scores enter the averaged profile. At inference time the full averaged profile is always presented with an “if applicable” framing, so nothing about the encounter type leaks through which dimensions appear.
blocks.zh: 在样式确定过程中,剖析器可以对没有被遇到时所行使的任何维度表示N/A;只有行使的分数输入平均剖析. 在推论时,总要用“适用”的框框来描述整个平均剖面,因此,没有涉及出现维度的碰撞类型泄漏。

blocks.en: Two caveats. First, the 1–5 Likert scale is convenient to average and plot, but we do not expect the coder LLM to follow it linearly; each score maps to an explicit written behavior description (§ 4.3 ), and discrete written categories per dimension (e.g., “codes from the imported problem list” vs. “codes only newly addressed problems”) may be a more faithful parameterization. Second, the rubric was authored by us from data inspection and conversations with professional coders.
blocks.zh: 二劝戒. 首先,1–5的Irikrt比例表是方便进行平均和绘图的,但我们并不期望编码器LLM会线性地遵循它;每个分数图到一个明确的书面行为描述(§4.3),每个维度的离散书面类别(例如,“从导入的问题列表中得出的代码”与“只有新处理的问题的代码”)可能是一种更忠实的参数化. 第二,这个标题是由我们从数据检查和与专业编码员的对话中撰写的。

blocks.en: 4.2 Style Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 样式方法

blocks.en: For each dataset we hold out 150 encounters as a “train” split, score them with the profiler, and average the exercised dimensions into a single dataset-level style ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} used at test time. The base coder is a Zero-shot prompt (full text in Appendix C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们以“火车”的分数进行150次碰头,用剖面仪来评分,并将所显示的维度平均为测试时使用的单一数据集级样式。 基码器为零射速率(全文见附录C.1 ).

blocks.en: • Zero-shot (no style): the Zero-shot coder with no style block; a lower reference point. • Dataset Avg Style: the averaged ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} derived from the target dataset’s train split (the “matched” condition). • Style Oracle: ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} is replaced by a per-encounter profile scored from that encounter’s own (note, gold codes); an upper bound on what style conditioning can recover when the gold coder’s style is known exactly. • Styles all-1s and Styles all-5s: extreme controls that set every dimension to the minimum (1) or maximum (5) of the 1–5 scale, representing the conservative and aggressive ends of the coding spectrum. If style were descriptive noise, these would leave F1 unchanged.

blocks.en: 4.3 Conditioning the Model at Inference
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 对模型进行推断

blocks.en: At inference the averaged profile ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} is rendered into a natural-language <coding_style> block that is prepended to the user message. Each of the 10 dimensions emits one paragraph carrying its integer score (1–5) and a written behavior description for that score. For Problem Scope, 1 means “code only the chief complaint”, 3 means “chief complaint plus problems actively addressed today”, and 5 means “every problem in the record”.
blocks.zh: 推论平均配置文件“\ psi\ prime}” 将变成一个自然语言的“ 编码_ style” 块, 用于预留给用户消息 。 10个维度中的每一个都发出一个带有整数分数(1–5)的段落,以及该分数的书面行为描述. 就“问题范围”而言,1表示“只按主要申诉编码”,3表示“主要申诉加上今天积极处理的问题”,5表示“记录中的每一个问题”。

<coding_style>

what and how to code this encounter.

=== ICD-10 CODING STYLE ===
PROBLEM SCOPE (3/5, if applicable):
Code the chief complaint plus all problems that
were actively addressed today (a clinical action
was taken or decision was made).

[...continues for all 10 dimensions...]
</coding_style>

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: All reported F1 numbers are sample-averaged: we compute a set-based F1 between predicted and gold ICD codes per encounter and take the unweighted mean over encounters. The overall F1 is the mean over encounters pooled across datasets (i.e., doc-weighted, not the mean of per-dataset means). Anthropic Opus 4.8 is used for all prompt based methods.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的F1数字都是抽样平均数:我们计算每次接触的预测值和黄金ICD代码之间的设定值F1,并采用未加权平均值。 总体F1是跨数据集(即Doc加权,而不是每个数据集的平均值)的偶遇。 所有即时方法都使用Anthropic Opus 4.8。

blocks.en: 5.1 Separability: Style Separates Data
blocks.zh: 5.1 分离性:样式分离数据

blocks.en: If ψ \psi is a real property of a data source rather than per-note noise, per-encounter style vectors should cluster by dataset. We project the six ICD-only style dimensions and the four CPT-only style dimensions in isolation with UMAP ( McInnes et al., 2018 ) (Figure 2 ), so that ICD-coding style and CPT-coding style are evaluated as separate signals.
blocks.zh: 如果\\ psi 是一个数据源的不动产,而不是每个音符的噪声,则每个相机样式向量应该通过数据集分组. 我们用UMAP(McInnes等人,2018年)(图2)孤立地投射了6个只使用ICD的样式维度和4个只使用CPT的样式维度,从而将ICD的编码样式和CPT的编码样式评价为单独的信号.

blocks.en: Figure 2: UMAP of per-encounter style vectors, colored and shaped by dataset. (a) ICD dimensions alone (S1–S6), including MIMIC-IV: datasets show visible regional biases but substantial mixing. (b) CPT dimensions alone (C1–C4), restricted to CONV/EHR which have CPT codes.
blocks.zh: 图2:每个场景样式矢量的UMAP,由数据集配色和形状. (a) 仅ICD尺寸(S1-S6),包括MIMIC-IV:数据集显示明显的区域偏差,但大量混合。 (b) 仅欧洲防止酷刑委员会(C1-C4)的维度仅限于具有欧洲防止酷刑委员会编码的CONV/EHR。

blocks.en: 5.2 Steerability: ICD Conditioning on Style
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 可引导性: 国际疾病分类 样式条件

blocks.en: We condition the coder on a style profile estimated using various strategies, plus two extreme profiles (all-1s and all-5s, representing the conservative and aggressive ends of the coding spectrum) as a control: if style were merely descriptive noise, injecting an extreme profile would leave F1 unchanged (Table 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们利用各种策略,加上两个极端剖面(所有-1和所有5,代表编码谱系的保守和激进端),将编码器设定为一种样式简介:如果样式仅仅是描述性噪音,注入极端剖面将保持不变(表5.2)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Per-dataset ICD F1 by conditioning strategy. Matched style helps every outpatient dataset (most on the narrow-scope EHR, + 26.4 +26.4 ) but not inpatient MIMIC-IV ( − 2.7 -2.7 ; § 5.2 ), per-sample oracle profiles help further, and the extreme all-5s style drops F1 by 10–21 points everywhere, showing the model follows the injected style.
blocks.zh: 表4:每个数据集的ICD F1通过调制策略. 匹配的样式帮助了每个门诊数据集(大多在窄镜EHR,+26.4+26.4),但不在住院的MIMIC-IV(−2.7−2.7;§5.2),每个样本甲骨文剖面可以进一步帮助,极端的5s样式将F1降低10–21点,显示模型遵循注射样式.

blocks.en: 5.3 Steerability: CPT Conditioning on Style
blocks.zh: 5.3 可引导性:欧洲防止酷刑委员会 样式条件

blocks.en:
CPT tells a different story (Table 5.3 ; ACI-Y/ACI-M lack CPT gold annotations).
Matching a dataset’s style improves F1 on CONV by + 5.4 +5.4 points but leave EHR essentially unchanged ( − 1.6 -1.6 ). This is in contrast to the large ICD gains of up to + 24 +24 (Table 5.2 ).
Extreme profiles still cause large drops,
so the coder does follow CPT instructions when they are informative.
We hypothesize there is simply less CPT style variation to exploit:
two of the four CPT dimensions have nearly identical means across CONV/EHR
(Table 3 ,
and while C1 and C4 do differ, the matched profile averages these out.
Matched profiles can only help to the extent that profiles differ across corpora. This suggests that in these corpora style variation lives mostly in ICD scope decisions rather than in procedure coding or that the style dimensions and/or model’s ability to apply them works less well for CPT.

blocks.en: 5.4 Same-Note Cross-Annotator (ACI-Y/ACI-M)
blocks.zh: 5.4 同注交叉注释(ACI-Y/ACI-M)

blocks.en:
ACI-Y and ACI-M annotate the same 110 notes independently, and their inter-annotator Jaccard similarity is only 73 % 73\% . To isolate style from coding error, we had every ICD-10 code in both annotations independently audited by clinical coders and marked defensible or not (§ A ); after erroneous codes are removed, the two annotators still agree on only 77 % 77\% of their codes. Because the remaining codes are individually defensible on the note, this residual gap is style, not clinical disagreement. Yet the averaged rubric profiles we recover for ACI-Y and ACI-M are nearly identical (Table 3 ):
they agree on five of six ICD dimensions and differ mainly on S2 ( 1.76 1.76 vs. 1.40 1.40 ). We take this as a rubric-coverage limitation: the ten dimensions were designed on CONV/EHR and do not fully cover the axes on which these two annotator groups disagree. Nevertheless, per-sample oracle profiles still recover + 23 +23 points against either gold (Table 5.4 ), all-1s styles are roughly neutral ( + 3 +3 vs. ACI-Y, + 9 +9 vs. ACI-M), and opposite (all-5s) styles drop F1 by − 20 -20 : style operates at the per-note decision level even when aggregate profiles cannot distinguish the annotators.
blocks.zh:
ACI-Y和ACI-M独立地标注了相同的110个音符,他们之间的注释员Jaccard的相似性只有73%的73\%. 为了将样式与编码错误区分开来,我们在两个注释中都有了每个ICD-10代码,分别由临床编码员独立审核,并标出是否可辨读(§A);在错误代码被删除后,两个注释员仍然只同意了77%的77QQ代码. 由于剩余代码在音符上可以单独辨别,这个剩余漏洞是风格性的,而不是临床上的分歧. 然而,我们为ACI-Y和ACI-M回收的均值图谱几乎相同(表3):
他们就6个ICD维度中的5个达成一致,主要在S2(1.761.76对1.401.40. 我们将此视为一个线性覆盖限制:十个维度是在CONV/EHR上设计的,并没有完全覆盖这两个注释组不同意的轴心. 尽管如此,每个样本甲骨文剖面图仍相对于任何一个金币恢复+23+23点(表5.4),所有-1s样式大致中性(+3+3 vs. ACI-Y,+9+9 vs. ACI-M),反面(所有5s)样式将F1降为−20-20:即使汇总剖面图无法区分注释者时,样式仍按每注决定级别运行.

blocks.en: Table 7: ICD F1 on the shared ACI-Bench notes across different annotators. Per-sample profiles recover + 23 +23 points against either gold despite nearly identical aggregate styles: style acts at the per-note level.
blocks.zh: 表7:不同注释者共享ACI-Bench注释上的ICD F1. 逐样剖面图在几乎完全相同的集合样式下,对两种金币的比分恢复+23+23:样式表现在每注一级.

blocks.en: 5.5 Generalizability: Augmenting Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 5.5 普遍性:加强现有方法

blocks.en:
If style is a property of the data rather than of our coder, style conditioning should help any coding method. We test this against two published prompt-based LLM coding pipelines as baselines: the two-step pipeline of Boyle et al. (2023) and the verify pipeline of Yuan et al. (2025) , running each with and without the injected style block. As an additional reference point, we also include Optimized ZS: our best attempt at prompt-engineering a zero-shot coder without style conditioning, representing a ceiling of what prompt design alone can achieve. As supervised references, we also report two MIMIC-IV ICD-10 baselines from the replicability study of Edin et al. (2023) : CAML ( Mullenbach et al., 2018 ) and PLM-ICD ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , which take no style input and appear only in the no-style condition.
In Table 5.3 we observe matched style improves every method on the outpatient corpora (it is neutral on inpatient MIMIC-IV; § 5.2 ), and the minimal-prompt Zero-shot coder gains the most, landing at 60.0 60.0 F1, indistinguishable from Optimized ZS+matched ( 59.8 59.8 ). Prompt engineering (Zero-shot → \rightarrow Optimized ZS) achieves + 11.8 +11.8 F1 by itself; style conditioning alone matches or exceeds that gain and is orthogonal to the coding method.
blocks.zh:
如果样式是数据属性而不是我们的编码器属性,样式调节应该有助于任何编码方法. 我们用两条已公布的快速LLM编码管道作为基线进行测试:Boyle等人的双步管道(2023年)和袁等人的验证管道(2025年),每条管道都以注入的样式块运行。 作为另一个参考点,我们还包括了优化ZS:我们最努力的即时工程,一个没有风格条件的零射线编码器,代表了即时设计能够实现的上限. 作为监督参考,我们还从Edin等人(2023年)的可复制性研究中报告两个MIMIC-IV ICD-10基线:CAML(Mullenbach等人,2018年)和PLM-ICD(Huang等人,2022年),它们不采用风格输入,只在无风格条件下出现.
在表5.3中,我们观察到对应的样式改进了门诊部的每一种方法(在住院的MIMIC-IV上是中性的;第5.2节),最小速率的零射码器增益最大,降落在600.0 60.0 F1,与优化的ZS+配对(59.8 59.8). 即时工程(Zero-shot →\rightarrow Optimized ZS)本身就实现+11.8+11.8 F1;光是样式调节就符合或超过该增益,与编码方法是正交的.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Style dominates ICD F1 across four style conditions. Within each style group, the four LLM coders (colored bars) sit at nearly the same height: the injected style, not the choice of coding method, dominates F1. Style conditioning lifts every method to ∼ \sim 57–60 F1. CAML and PLM-ICD (supervised MIMIC references, no style input) are shown only in the no-style group.
blocks.zh: 图3:风格主导 ICD F1 跨越四个风格条件. 在每个样式组内,四个LLM编码器(彩色条)的高度几乎相同:注射式,而不是选择编码方法,主导F1. 样式调节将每种方法都提升到\\sim 57–60 F1. CAML和PLM-ICD(监督的MIMIC引用,没有样式输入)只在无样式组中显示.

blocks.en: The extreme mismatched styles serve as the control here: an all-5s profile collapses F1 for every method, so all four follow the injected style rather than ignoring it. The all-1s profile hurts Optimized ZS but helps the other methods. Coders that were not heavily prompt-optimized are more receptive to any style instruction.
blocks.zh: 极端不匹配的样式在这里充当了控制:一个全5s的配置崩溃F1的每个方法,所以所有四个都遵循注入的样式而不是忽略它. 所有一号的档案都疼了 优化ZS但帮助其他方法. 没有大力迅速优化的编码员更能接受任何风格指示.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Style has real impact. Separable clusters, matched-style gains, and large wrong-style drops all support treating coding style as a latent variable rather than annotation noise; the strongest single piece of evidence is that ACI-Y and ACI-M share only 73 % 73\% of their codes (Jaccard) on identical notes, and that an independent clinical audit lifts this only to 77 % 77\% after erroneous codes are removed. We do not claim the ten rubric dimensions are the one true set of styles, only that they capture enough of the variation to move F1 substantially.
blocks.zh: 风格有真正的影响。 可分离的集群,匹配式的增益,以及大错式的降低所有支持将编码风格视为潜在变量而不是注释噪声;最强的单一证据是ACI-Y和ACI-M在相同音符上只共享73%的代码(Jaccard),独立临床审计在删除错误代码后仅将这个比例提升到77%的77\%. 我们并不宣称这十大维是一套真正的风格,只是它们能捕捉到足够大的变异,从而大幅度地移动F1.

blocks.en: The model has sufficient coding knowledge; style unlocks more. Once an appropriate profile is supplied, our zero-shot coder, Optimized ZS, Two-Step, and Yuan-Verify converge to within 4 F1 points. Strikingly, Zero-shot+matched ( 60.0 60.0 ) matches Optimized ZS+matched ( 59.8 59.8 ): style conditioning can be viewed as a controlled form of prompt optimization.
blocks.zh: 该模型具有足够的编码知识;样式解锁更多. 一旦提供了适当的剖面,我们的零射码器,优化的ZS,双步和元-威力在4F1点内汇合. strikingly, Zero-shot+ matched (60.0 60.0) 匹配最优化的ZS+ matched (59.8 59.8):样式调节可以看作是一种控制形式的即时优化.

blocks.en: A lower bound. The rubric closes a substantial fraction of the F1 gap but does not capture all of style: ACI-Y and ACI-M share only 73 % 73\% of their codes ( 77 % 77\% after an independent clinical audit removes errors) yet have nearly identical averaged profiles (Table 3 ), so additional style axes exist beyond the current ten. Inpatient MIMIC-IV is a second, independent witness: its profile saturates the top of the outpatient-derived 1 1 – 5 5 scale, and matched style does not help there even though the extreme styles still move F1 (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 一个下限。 标题关闭了F1缺口的相当一部分,但并未捕捉到所有的样式:ACI-Y和ACI-M只分享了73%的73\%代码(在独立临床审核消除错误后为77%的77\%),然而却拥有几乎相同的平均剖面(表3),因此额外的样式轴存在于目前的10个之外. 住院的MIMIC-IV是第二个独立证人:它的剖面饱和了门诊产生的1 1 – 5 5 缩放的顶部,配对的风格在那里也无济于事,尽管极端的风格仍然移动着F1(§ 5.2).

blocks.en: Evaluation. Single-gold F1 underestimates LLM capability on style-mismatched data. Reporting style-conditioned F1, or at least characterizing the corpus ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} , would make coding evaluations more comparable.
blocks.zh: 评价。 单金F1低估了样式匹配数据的LLM能力. 报告风格附带条件的F1, 或至少是描述"\ psi\prime}", 将使编码评价更具可比性。

blocks.en: Style vs. compliance. We use “style” descriptively. Some preferences sit within the guidelines (Z-code completeness, specificity); others approach the boundary of compliance (e.g., coding a diagnosis documented only as probable). Our framework measures these preferences; it does not endorse them.
blocks.zh: 样式对遵守。 我们使用“风格”的描述。 一些偏好属于准则(Z码完整性,特异性);其他偏好则接近遵守的界限(例如,将只记录的诊断编码为可能). 我们的框架衡量这些偏好;它不赞同这些偏好。

blocks.en: Appendix A ACI-Bench code defensibility audit
blocks.zh: ACI-Bench代码辨识性审计

blocks.en:
To isolate coding style from coding error, we conducted an independent human audit of the ICD-10 codes on the shared ACI-Bench notes. Two clinical coders reviewed every ICD-10 code produced by ACI-Y and ACI-M side-by-side per note, marking each individual code as defensible or not defensible ; a free-text reason was required for every not-defensible verdict.
Across the 110 notes audited, ACI-Y’s codes are 89.8 % 89.8\% defensible ( 202 / 225 202/225 ) and ACI-M’s are 86.4 % 86.4\% ( 197 / 228 197/228 ): the vast majority of each annotator’s output is a supportable coding choice on the note. Recomputing the vendor-vs-vendor overlap on the audit-verified subset (i.e., removing not-defensible codes from each side before taking the set intersection and union) raises the per-note Jaccard from 73 % 73\% to 77 % 77\% .
blocks.zh:
为了将编码风格从编码错误中分离出来,我们对共享的ACI-Bench笔记上的ICD-10代码进行了独立的人文审核. 两名临床编码员逐笔审查了ACI-Y和ACI-M公司生产的每个ICD-10代码,将每个单个代码标为可辩驳或不可辩驳;每个不可辩驳的判决需要自由文字的理由.
在审计的110份说明中,ACI-Y的代码是89.8% / 89.8\% 的可辩证(202/225/225),ACI-M的代码是86.4% / 86.4\%(197/228 197/228):每个注释员的产出绝大多数都是该说明上一个可以支持的编码选择。 校对供应商Vs-vendor在审计验证子集上的重叠(即,在采取设定的交叉点和结合点之前,从每一边去掉不可防御的代码),将每个笔记的Jaccard从73 % 73%提高到77 % 77%。
